limitations: Cohorts are post-run diagnostics; all 308 tuning recordings remain in overall denominators.
Very short loops have limited single-pass periodicity evidence; no repeated/transformed audio was substituted.
Tuning measurements do not qualify accuracy; broad combined genre tags do not establish required strata.
Full remote archive MD5 is unverified; each admitted member passed ZIP CRC and SHA256 checks.
Throughput covers decoder/analyzer only, excluding database and GUI work.
